reason: Two actual original-owner attempts established that the installed watcher rejects C# IndexerName edits as ENC0108 and all VB edits as ENC1009. Neither restart is invalidation evidence. Do not retain a mutable metadata cache in an update-enabled process.

selectedDesignToValidate.cache: Successful MethodInfo classifications only,using a ConditionalWeakTable with weak lifetime semantics.
selectedDesignToValidate.runtimeOnly: Only publish successful results discovered on a genuine runtime Type. Non-runtime reflection adapters continue through unchanged discovery on every call.
selectedDesignToValidate.metadataUpdates: Bypass both cache reads and publication whenever MetadataUpdater.IsSupported is true. Continue using the original on-demand metadata path,so no cache invalidation or new update handler is necessary in update-enabled processes.
selectedDesignToValidate.runtimeCapabilityContract: The public BCL property reports whether assembly updates are enabled and available. The documentation-linked CoreCLR implementation initializes a get-only property from IsApplyUpdateSupported. This external reference is not asserted to be the exact installed runtime source.
selectedDesignToValidate.indexValues: Never cache captured index values or full indexed expression text.
selectedDesignToValidate.noNewApi: No new public/protected surface,flags or cross-framework internal calls.

lifecycleCriterionReplacement.normalProcess: Prove the actual compiled owner eliminates repeated successful metadata allocations when metadata updates are unavailable,without changing expression results or collectible metadata lifetime.
lifecycleCriterionReplacement.watchedProcess: Under the actual watcher,observe MetadataUpdater.IsSupported=true,and resource evidence that the actual classifier still performs the original allocating metadata reads. lifecycleCriterionReplacement.negativeControl: A diagnostic cache-enabled-under-Hot-Reload prototype must fail the live-path resource assertion. This tests the deliberate bypass policy,not an unobserved classification-changing metadata edit.
